import { OrderService } from "../src/order_service";

describe("OrderService", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    // setup
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    // teardown
  });

  it("places an order", async () => {
    const svc = new OrderService();
    await svc.placeOrder({ id: "1" });
  });

  describe("cancel", () => {
    it("cancels happy path", async () => {
      const svc = new OrderService();
      await svc.cancelOrder({ id: "2" });
    });
    test.skip("noop on already-cancelled", () => {});
  });

  it("publishes order.created", async () => {
    const topic = "order.created";
    expect(topic).toBeDefined();
  });
});
